data.title: HYPE, ADA Outperform Bitcoin, Ethereum and XRP As Strait Of Hormuz Tensions Keep Crypto Markets On The Edge
data.description: Cardano (ADA) and Hyperliquid (HYPE) outperformed major cryptocurrencies on Tuesday, despite uncertainty over U.S.-Iran talks and fresh shipping risks in the Strait of Hormuz weighing on investor sentiment.ADA price is up more than 4%, and HYPE price was up over 3% in the last 24 hours.
